=== refused: addi to memory on a ColdFire
        addil   #5,%a0@
=== refused: a byte-sized add on a ColdFire
        addb    %d0,%d1
=== refused: Scc to memory on a ColdFire
        seq     %a0@
=== refused: movem with predecrement on a ColdFire
        moveml  %d0-%d3,%sp@-
=== refused: a memory shift on a ColdFire
        asl     %a0@
=== refused: a word index register on a ColdFire
        movel   %a0@(4,%d1:w),%d2
=== refused: bra.l on a ColdFire ISA_A
        .arch   5206
        bral    far
far:    rts
